### Load in Data
```{r}
# get data from rds
song <- readRDS("rds/song_longevity.rds")
str(song)
```

### Generate Audio Profile Clusters and Elbow Curve
```{r}
# Focus on audio profile of music
audio_prof <- c("energy", "valence", "danceability", "acousticness", "instrumentalness", "tempo_bpm", "song_length_sec")
songs_audio <- song[ ,audio_prof]
# scale data
minmax <- function(x) (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
songs_audio <- as.data.frame(lapply(songs_audio, minmax))

# Create Clusters for Kmeans Analysis
set.seed(12345)
kmeans_model <- kmeans(songs_audio, centers = 4)

# Create elbow plot to find optimal number of clusters
wss <- sapply(1:10, function(k) {
  kmeans(songs_audio, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 50)$tot.withinss
})

# plot the elbow plot
plot(1:10, wss, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
     ylab = "Total within-cluster sum of squares",
     main = "Elbow Plot")
```

### Audio Profile Clusters
```{r}
# Size and success rate of each cluster
kmeans_model$size     

# cluster means for each variable
kmeans_model$centers
```

### Generate Promotion Strategy Profile Clusters and Elbow Curve
```{r}
# Focus on promotion strategy of music
promo <- c("marketing_budget", "playlist_adds_first_month", "editorial_playlist", "tiktok_virality", "artist_prior_monthly_listeners")
songs_p <- song[ ,promo]
# scale data
minmax <- function(x) (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
songs_p <- as.data.frame(lapply(songs_p, minmax))

# Create Clusters for Kmeans Analysis
set.seed(12345)
kmeans_model_p <- kmeans(songs_p, centers = 2)

# Create elbow plot to find optimal number of clusters
wss <- sapply(1:10, function(k) {
  kmeans(songs_p, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 50)$tot.withinss
})

# plot the elbow plot
plot(1:10, wss, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
     ylab = "Total within-cluster sum of squares",
     main = "Elbow Plot")
```

### Promo Strategy Clusters
```{r}
# Size and success rate of each cluster
kmeans_model_p$size     

# cluster means for each variable
kmeans_model_p$centers
```
